title: 19. Fear in the Dark
text: * Bigwig’s word was hlessil, which I have rendered in various places in the story as wanderers, scratchers, vagabonds. A hlessi is a rabbit living in the open, without a hole. Solitary bucks and unmated rabbits who are wandering do this for quite long periods, especially in summer. Bucks do not usually dig much in any case, although they will scratch shallow shelters or make use of existing holes where these are available. Real digging is done for the most part by does preparing for litters. * Zorn! means ‘finished’ or ‘destroyed’, in the sense of some terrible catastrophe.
